p4_b8.ocr: Gastrostomy/jejunostomy in the CDKL5 disorder Over a quarter (28.8 %, 42/146) of individuals had had a gastrostomy or jejunostomy tube inserted due to various and sometimes multiple reasons including feeding diffi- culties (80.0 %), poor weight gain (60.0 %), difficulty with administration of medications (62.9 %) and poor general health and wellbeing (51.4 %). Time to event analysis showed that males were more likely to undergo gastrostomy than females (log rank test p = 0.013) with a quarter of males having gastrostomy in- sertion by age 2.6 (95 % CI 1.60, 4.34) compared to 7.4 years (95 % CI 4.64,-) for females (Fig. 1).
